svg.title: coderprint: 673k lines of code in use, of 893k written, all time
svg.desc: 673,475 lines of code in use (459,832 in production, 213,643 in tests), of 893,471 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 2,826 commits across all branches, 55 active days, a longest streak of 40 days, a current streak of 40 days, and 5 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 818k lines of code. The bars end on 17OCT2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 41%, Lean 30%, Python 14%, TypeScript 9%, JavaScript 5%, other languages 1%. Of what was written, 75% is kept.
